integrity: The finite-dimensional quotient theorem and its exact norm-distance law are analytically proved, subject to independent review. Related versions of an earlier geodesic paper were compared directly; the metric-graph corollary is not claimed original.
limitations: For real atomless finite L1 and arbitrary finite-dimensional quotient kernels only. No priority claim for geodesic metric graphs, for which a stronger theorem was asserted in the 2022 first version of Kaasik--Veeorg and narrowed in its 2023 revision; not for infinite-dimensional kernels or complex scalars.
title: Finite-dimensional quotients of real atomless \(L^1\) are weakly almost square
